title: The LSTM keeps the cat
notes: The same sentence through an LSTM. Cat opens the input gate (0.95) and writes 0.92 into the cell. After that every forget gate is σ(3) = 0.953, so the cell keeps most of it: 0.65 at slept, and word 1's pull is 0.953 to the 7th, 0.71. The output gate opens for the verbs, so h shows the cat at sat and slept.
ops: cat sat on the mat and it slept
